column1: # Per-agent provider catalog. One record per agent and provider.
# agent|provider|package or release|version|policy|commands|platforms|order|selection|herdr kind|minimum node|trusted dependencies|lock or manifest|diagnostic
# provider          bun (frozen Bun project), native (verified release), homebrew
#                   (installer-owned command adopted from the device).
# package           npm package (bun) or the native release binary (native); - otherwise.
# version           the version this provider supplies.
# policy            exact (the provider must supply exactly this version) or
#                   floor (the provider must supply at least this version).
# commands          the commands this provider exposes.
# platforms         all, unix, windows, linux, macos, or wsl.
# order             provider chain order; the lowest order is tried first.
# selection         selectable (named selection) or always (installed whatever
#                   the selection says).
# herdr kind        the Herdr integration kind, or - when the agent has none.
# minimum node      the lowest Node the package supports (bun records only).
# trusted           the deliberate lifecycle trust list (bun records only).
# lock or manifest  the Bun lock path (bun) or the release manifest base (native).
# diagnostic        the expected --version output; - means the diagnostic must
#                   contain the version, otherwise {version} is replaced by it.
